Modi positions India as global partner amid supply chain concerns

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that India offers itself as a trusted global partner, emphasizing that the nation grows "with the world, not at anyone's cost." He made these remarks at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum, citing strong economic fundamentals. Modi's comments come amid global challenges and a perceived "weaponization" of supply chains.
